LightningComponentBundle.description: The opening block of a pillar page: an eyebrow, the page's one heading, a lead paragraph and a link to the design.

property.name: eyebrow
property.label: Eyebrow
property.description: Short line above the heading, for example Pillar A.

property.name: heading
property.label: Heading
property.description: The page's one top level heading.

property.name: lead
property.label: Lead
property.description: The opening paragraph, shown in a larger size.

property.name: designLabel
property.label: Design link text
property.description: Text of the design link. Read the design when blank.

property.name: designUrl
property.label: Design link URL
property.description: An https address, a site path starting with a slash, or an anchor. No link when blank.
